scopes.sync_root_read: Read sync folders, lifecycle files, and client reports.
scopes.sync_root_write: Create sync folders, lock files, lifecycle files, and client reports.
scopes.sync_root_delete: Remove run state, report files, or entire sync folders.

approval.default: Caller must have local filesystem permissions for the configured root.
approval.destructive: reset and remove should be invoked only by the owner of the sync_id.
